name: Orchestral & Film
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For orchestral music and film and game soundtracks. The full dynamic range is kept: there is no maximizer drive, no clipper and no compression, only a slow, transparent limiter at -1 dBTP. Timpani, low brass and bass drops get a deeper low end (about +1.5 dB below 60 Hz), the upper mids are about 1 dB softer at 2-4 kHz so massed strings and brass do not turn edgy on headphones, and a touch of air and hall and Meier crossfeed give a natural headphone stage. Made for headphones; on speakers, set Headphone Crossfeed to 0.
